# Personal-growth graph fixture

`personal-growth-authored.json` was written for the Capicove test suite. It is
project-authored synthetic content released under CC0-1.0; it does not contain
user data, copied source material, or model output.

The four text-origin documents exercise two independent owner-authored error
events, one owner-authored checklist intervention and observed outcome, and one
book-author claim followed by an adversarial command. Authorship is explicit so
the test can prove that quoted claims by another person do not become personal
diagnostic evidence. The scripted provider returns bounded deterministic JSON
derived only from this fixture. No network, model download, Temporal Memory, or
Wiki component participates in the test.

`identity_groups` is trusted fixture-host metadata, not model output. It states
that the three owner pronouns denote one directory subject and that the three
explicit `boundary` error mentions denote one subject-bound error pattern. The
E2E host resolver emits aliases only for those declared group members; it never
promotes fuzzy name or embedding similarity. For every pair it cites the third
member document, keeping alias evidence independent from both endpoint mentions.
